subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Acme Corp MAP recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Acme Corp MAP recap

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the context on Acme's multi-region privacy needs and the timeline pressure to have a pilot by end of Q2. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment.

Key pain points we heard
- High latency and cost for current embedding/search pipeline at scale (esp. EU-region traffic)
- Regulatory requirement to keep PII inside EU for a subset of customers; need VPC/on-prem options for those accounts
- Lack of predictable SLAs and capacity planning for sales-critical workloads

Goals you stated
1) Pilot Redwood Private in a single EU region for a small set of merchants by end of Q2 (target week of 2027-06-21)
2) Validate latency <150ms p95 for search/checkout flows and quantify per-token cost vs current infra
3) Finalize procurement and security questionnaires, then enter a dedicated contract if pilot passes

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (milestones, owners, dates)
- 1) Pilot kickoff: 2027-03-07 — Owner: Acme (Alex, Sophie) + Redwood (Marissa, Vivek) — Technical kickoff, credentials, scope for pilot (1 EU region, 3 merchants) — Attachment: redwood_map_template.xlsx
- 2) Security & compliance exchange: 2027-03-14 — Owner: Acme (security contact) + Redwood (Naomi) — Share SOC2 evidence, network diagram, KMS controls — Action: Acme to send completed questionnaire
- 3) Pilot run (data collection): 2027-04-01 to 2027-05-31 — Owner: Acme + Redwood — Daily dashboards and weekly checkpoints; target p95 latency <150ms
- 4) Commercial review & procurement: 2027-06-07 — Owner: Acme procurement + Redwood sales — Final pricing, contract redlines (if pilot OK)
- 5) Go/no-go decision: 2027-06-21 — Owner: Acme execs + Redwood leadership — If go, plan Dedicated capacity reservation and rollout

Decision process / stakeholders (as stated on call)
- Technical approvers: Sophie Lee (Head of Platform), Vivek will be Redwood's technical lead during pilot
- Security/compliance: unnamed security contact (you said you would loop them in; please add name/email)
- Procurement / legal: procurement@acme.com (we should get primary contact)
- Executive approver: Alex Johnson (you indicated you will present final ROI to the product execs)

Immediate next steps (items for this week)
1) I will send the MAP template (attached) and a short onboarding checklist — DONE (attached: redwood_map_template.xlsx)
2) Alex/Sophie: please confirm the security contact and procurement primary by 2027-02-12
3) Redwood (Naomi): will prepare SOC2 pack and a preliminary pricing sheet tailored to the pilot — ETA 2027-02-12

If that aligns, I'll update the MAP with the exact contacts and push to HubSpot (link included below).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: redwood_map_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Acme Corp MAP recap

Thanks Marissa — this is great and captures the ask. A couple quick notes:

- Confirmed timeline looks good from my side. I will present the pilot plan to the product execs next week.
- Security contact: Sophie Lee (sophie.lee@acme.com) will own security review; I will put Procurement (procurement@acme.com) in the loop.
- Can you include a rough estimate of expected token spend for the pilot and an upper bound on monthly cost? That will help procurement and finance.

I'll loop in Sophie and procurement after I sync with them this afternoon.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing sheet for Acme pilot (draft)

Marissa / Vivek —

I put together a draft pricing sheet and a conservative token-spend estimate for the pilot. Main assumptions included: 3 merchants, 100k requests/day, average response 240 tokens. See attached.

Highlights:
- Estimated monthly token spend (pilot): ~216M tokens — est. cost $X,XXX/month at pilot config
- With prefix caching and batch-config the effective cost per request could drop ~30% on production

Attaching: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf

I'll update the MAP with these numbers once we have the confirmed scope.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Subject: Updated MAP + HubSpot link — Acme pilot

Alex / Sophie / Procurement —

Thanks for confirming Sophie as the security contact. I've updated the MAP with Naomi's draft pricing and included the security evidence delivery step. Quick note of next actions:

- Procurement: please review the preliminary pricing PDF attached and let us know if you need a formal SOW or PO template — we can prepare a standard pilot SOW for signature by 2027-03-03.
- Sophie: Naomi will send the SOC2/KMS artifacts by 2027-02-14; please confirm preferred secure transfer method (Dropbox Transfer / SFTP / shared Drive).
- Alex: Can you confirm Exec decision slot for week of 2027-06-21? We'll reserve that date in the MAP.

Updated MAP link (read-only): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/RDW-ACME-2027-042
Doc for signature (sent via DocuSign): acme_signature_request.docusign

If everyone agrees, I'll mark the MAP as 'confirmed' in HubSpot and schedule the kickoff for 2027-03-07.

Best,
Marissa
